preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some NOMOS tokens to initiate the attack
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default after presale)
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens in marketingAccumulator to trigger swapTokens function

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract that implements a reentrancy attack in its fallback/receive function. First, ensure the victim contract has accumulated marketing fees. Then call transfer() to the Uniswap pair with an amount that triggers swapAndLiquify. During the ETH transfer in swapTokensForEth or transferToAddressETH, the malicious contract's fallback will reenter and execute additional operations before state updates complete. The attack should drain ETH from the contract by repeatedly reentering during the vulnerable external call.
